acceptanceCriteria: Unmerged/unreviewed/mutated source cannot promote; mandatory full tests precede stable movement; every target result names the same promoted SHA and partial failure remains resumable and visible.
nonGoals: No manual remote checkout updates, inferred deployment targets, untested source synchronization or service-specific rollout.
dependencies: #28 depends on #27. #29 depends on #28 and #18. This replaces the provisional dependency on all of #20; #18 no longer waits for this whole parent.
suggestedWorkBreakdown: Implement immutable reviewed-SHA promotion #28 after merge-evidence #27; implement end-to-end release orchestration #29 after #28 and the independent retry/receipt work #18.

subIssues.title: Promote only a verified merged dev SHA with an immutable full-test gate
subIssues.body: Make stable promotion prove the exact tested commit is a reviewed merged dev commit, with no public test replacement. See fully planned child #28. Temporary bare remotes and fake GitHub evidence; absent stable versus failed fetch, merge/squash/rebase histories, failure/no public override, concurrent stable push and valid promotion; Windows/Linux Factory suite.

subIssues.title: Orchestrate Factory release phases from reviewed merge through target receipts
subIssues.body: Make operator and agent release instructions agree on one resumable release sequence and every configured target's result. See fully planned child #29. Mock target registry/API/host executors only; dry-run/partial-failure/retry fixtures; contract ownership checks and full Factory suite. Approved live verification uses homelab-ssh and supported host deployment only.
